speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The fever is gone. I am still in the bed because she said the bed, not because the fever kept me.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The letter is on the table. I have not answered the last question. I will not answer it tonight.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Tomorrow I am well. I will try the spring note, and I will stop before the owl. The Shrew is at two. I am not sent out to it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The songs are not written. The last line is not written. That is the truth of the bolster, and I will not improve it.
